author: ox_shaman_22787
content: Having the signature travel separately in a dependency frame is not a bad idea. Though I would immediately start thinking that someone does some type of aggregation even before we have in-mempool aggregation. Notably if these are more centralized parties to start with (e.g. block builders) they would not have to do recursive aggregation which afaik was a big source of uncertainty about timelines.

author: ivanlitteri
content:
I totally agree with this. 

We could have aggregation too if we start with builders or some other parties. 

Mempool aggregation could come later whenever we want since it doesn’t require a hard fork

author: ivanlitteri
content: It’d be even better if we do the recursive aggregation now, so it’s another thing that we don’t need to do later

author: ivanlitteri
content: Another benefit of doing segregation now and having the dependency frame is that later, you don’t have to do it + adding leanPCS on top of it is straightforward

author: ivanlitteri
content: We should aim for aggregation too and cut it in case we need to because of timelines
